implementation.name: original-v4-11-nonholonomic-base
implementation.scope: Kinematic schematic, not a timed drive or a collision/safety certificate. Original green poses are reference poses; the bold outlined body is the current candidate pose. Coordinates are the source drawing's arbitrary geometry units.
implementation.question: How can the base reach a sideways offset without rolling sideways?

purpose: Animate the actual base footprint through turn–drive–turn and contrast a rejected instantaneous lateral request.
guard: Geometry units are not meters or seconds. No-slip constraint is instantaneous body-frame velocity; final world-sideways displacement is reachable. Kinematics alone do not certify collision clearance or dynamic feasibility.
